role: DEV staged contact mechanism experiments; frozen original H75 u77 and orange Local300

P0.recording: post-solve force and own contact point for each normal/friction patch, joint velocity, body pose, applied motor torque; no 5ms subsampling for G1/G2

G1_G2.normal_and_friction_points: separate native PhysX buffers, no shared-point assumption
margin_metrics: motor saturation total and longest continuous duration
front low-load total and longest continuous duration
steering velocity before roll and path response

G3_G4.primary_event: first 50Hz decision after rear-wheel confirmed obstacle clearance
G3_G4.snapshot: same physical, controller, actuator, policy history and filter state; natural/restored comparison retained
G3_G4.status: event detector and branch implementation pending; transitions/additional event budget separately declared before execution

G5.report: actual delivered compensating angular impulse, steering-rate response, roll and task response
G5.flat_pulses: positive and negative matched impulse sensitivity

G6.comparison: same held-out conditions with and without contact migration/angular impulse features
G6.empty_feasible_set: retain violation, prioritize balance/completion then violation extent
G6.contact_truth: oracle feature set separate from deployable feature set

G7.status: last priority, not authorized for immediate model mutation

resource_policy: one heavy queued GPU job across threads, GPU-parallel lanes within job; at least50GB data-disk free; no repeated polling
claim_policy: negative trail magnitude, migration, unloading and real torque effects distinguished; no presupposed causal dominance
